scientific_integrity.limitations: The cutoff is an exact special-function minimum, without an elementary closed form. Only two positive rates and zero initial derivative are covered. Positive initial-time kernels do not imply a Markov or semi-Markov evolution. No extrapolation to higher state dimensions or derivative orders above two.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Analytical all-time classification with a normalized Fourier density and a determinant obstruction; finite checker is diagnostic.

title: Sharp all-time positivity for two-state superlinear Caputo propagators
